events.description: A man lies on the ground with severe facial injuries and blood, indicating he has been violently attacked and is helpless.
A man lies on the ground with fresh blood on his face and head, consistent with a recent gunshot wound; the injury appears severe and immediate.
A woman raises a pistol and aims it directly at another person in close proximity; the gun is held in a firing-ready position with finger on trigger, indicating imminent or ongoing shooting action.

A woman aims a handgun directly at an off-screen target; in frame f0 she raises the gun, in f1 she aligns it with her eye, and in f2 she fires—evidenced by visible muzzle flash and immediate recoil (gun shifts upward and backward). Frame f3 shows the gun still recoiling and lowering, confirming discharge.

The woman is violently struck (likely by a projectile or impact), causing her to stagger backward with arms flailing, head thrown back, and body contorting; dust/smoke erupts around her torso in frames f7–f10, consistent with high-impact force in a forest setting.
A woman in a leather jacket is engaged in a physical struggle, shown recoiling and being struck (visible smoke/dust suggests impact), consistent with active combat.
The woman appears to be on the ground or falling after impact, with visible distress and smoke/dust around her, suggesting she is a helpless victim being attacked.

A hand holding a handgun is visible in close-up; while no muzzle flash or bullet is seen, the framing and context suggest an imminent or just-occurred shot. However, due to lack of direct visual evidence of discharge (e.g., flash, recoil, bullet trail), confidence is moderate.
